svg.aria-label: A Plan of the Works. One: claude-kits, the method. Two: claude-kits-boutique, the proof, joined to it by a road marked 'proved on'. Three: lombard, the shop, joined by a road marked 'built with'. A coach travels from the method to the proof, returns, and goes on to the shop.
